column1: # chunk 40: does the player ask to talk about a topic? `ask` = Heard.topic_ask must be set (a topic is named after a phrase like tell me more about ...),
# `no` = it must not. Read by `langcheck --thread` (pass this file). Format: text<TAB>ask|no. Private test data, never shipped.
tell me more about the moon
tell me more about the stars
let us talk about the sea
can we talk about the night
i want to talk about the shrine
i wanna talk about the hammer
what do you think about the sky
tell me more about that door
hey lets talk about the moon
ok tell me about the orb
please tell me more about the sun
